newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen hit at opening by Intel.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen hit at opening by Intel.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were seen opening lower Friday, weighed down by predictions from chip maker Intel Corp that its second-quarter results would be below expectations.
Analysts said Intel's announcement that its second-quarter gross margins would be below the 64 percent mark in the first quarter would drag down the technology sector.
"It's batten down the hatches time. We're likely to see the tech sector ripped apart today," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co.
Intel was trading at 145-1/2 after closing Thursday at 163-49/64.
Analysts also said revised Gross Domestic Product figures for the first quarter were in line with expectations and should have little effect on the opening.
The government revised growth to 5.8 percent, up slightly from the initial figure of 5.6 percent.
